newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premier to decide soon on Discovery bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premier to decide soon on Discovery bid.

text.p: Premier Oil Plc said on Friday it will decide next week on a possible rise in its takeover bid for Discovery Petroleum NL if the Australian oil producer and explorer can prove that its assets are worth more.

"We have always said to Discovery that if they can demonstrate additional value we will increase our (70 cent per share) bid accordingly," Premier general manager of international and new business Stephen Lowden told Reuters.
Lowden met with the chairman and managing director of Discovery in Sydney on Thursday and will resume talks in their Perth head office next Monday.
"We will see if they can substantiate an increase in value to us. At that point in time we will make a decision as to what we do next," Lowden said.

So far, Discovery has not been able to convince Premier that its shares should be valued in the range of 77 to 95 cents per share allocated to the stock in an independent experts report by merchant bank Grant Samuel and Associaties.
Share market speculators have pushed Discovery shares to a 1996 high of 80 cents this week in the expectation that the takeover price will be increased or another bid will emerge.
Premier's bid values Discovery at A$91.2 million.
